units.source_text: 源氏公子对她说：“你也写一张看。”

en.t: Prince Genji said to her, "You try writing one too."

units.source_text: 紫儿仰望着源氏公子说：“我还写不好呢！”

en.t: Murasaki looked up at Prince Genji and said, "I still cannot write well!"

units.source_text: 态度天真烂漫，非常可爱。

en.t: Her manner was innocent and openhearted, and very adorable.

units.source_text: 源氏公子不由地满面堆上笑来，答道：“写不好就不写，是不好的。

en.t: Prince Genji could not help breaking into a broad smile and replied, "It is not good to refuse to write just because you cannot do it well.
So she turned aside and began to write.

units.source_text: 那手的姿势和运笔的方法，都是孩子气的，但也非常可爱，

en.t: The way she held her hand and moved the brush were both childish, but also very charming,

units.source_text: 使源氏公子真心地感到不可思议。

en.t: and they made Prince Genji feel genuinely amazed.

units.source_text: 羞答答地把纸隐藏起来。

en.t: She bashfully hid the paper away.

units.source_text: 源氏公子抢来一看，但见写着一首诗：

en.t: Prince Genji snatched it over to look, and saw that a poem was written there:
